catalog_comparison_scope: Material constants compare explicit representative mapping (ANY.Steel→Steel, ANY.W→Tungsten). This does not prove group ingredient recipes or resolved live material registry membership.

source_arithmetic.limit: Finite source arithmetic, not native world state or callback return equivalence.

mapped_milk_witness.preconditions: Source contains at least 1000 L milk; lower target accepts the full offer; no source/target race. Source decision witness only.

experience_witness.preconditions: No OpenBlocks override; empty hand; accessible source permits the named fluid; no below recipient. Source branch only.

comment_corrections: GT6 tap click: 250 L water/ordinary liquid, 1000 L lava, one material unit of molten metal.
Downward transfer currently uses 250 L by default, 1000 L lava or 144 L molten entries.
Existing IDs remain aliases of the original ceramic tap and steel nozzle.
Legacy tap/nozzle wrappers; material variants use FluidAttachmentBlock directly.

readability.normalization: Remove only the three verified new helper methods; expand two core and three native call sites back to their exact prior predicates. Normalize recorded local identifier changes before full remaining code/literal/comment/directive comparison.

core_probe.scope: Actual core definition and pre-edit class-name-only clone; native materials replaced by shared identity-only metadata stubs. Role oracle copied from the old native predicates. Not actual material bootstrap, sided IFluidHandler, native transactions, gameplay or whole mod compilation.

formal_findings_added.finding: Held Ender Garbage Bin command is missing on tap/nozzle; ordinary native fluid-container interaction does not replace it.
Tap has no lower-sandwich liquid ingredient path; current recipient search only asks ordinary fluid capability.
Mapped non-water liquid per-click amount is collapsed to 250 unless texture mode is molten; milk old 1000/current 250 under stated recipient conditions.
Normal material-variant explosion resistance collapsed to 6; 20 of 24 original declaration rows differ. No blast or overload change.
Tap empty-hand XP/mob essence conversion is absent. Requires a valid accessible corresponding fluid; optional OpenBlocks conversion and other external mods are not claimed tested.
Fluid attachments gained native outline collision; original shared attachment base returns null. No entity movement or rendered selection test.

Four bare base attachment IDs remain independent block/item registrations alongside 24 material IDs, rather than true registry aliases. Visibility, recipes and save migration are separate; no IDs removed here.

formal_findings_extended.scope: Successful empty-hand below tap pour lacks the original spray/water pair in the attachment and native transfer helper; target-owned sounds are not excluded.

rejected_or_bounded_findings: Neo TapBlock(true) source contains a cap_nozzle shape, but the actual Neo registration never constructs that wrapper; do not report a live Neo nozzle polarity defect from dead registration path.

Current river water passes isSame(WATER) through GTWorldWaterFluid; tag/identity override must be read before claiming cauldron water rejection. Sea/swamp broadening follows prior user water-family policy.
Current phase/acid screen and explicit FluidToolTarget preference already exist; new core helpers retain the exact existing predicates.
